text:
Maya: Heads up — hitting a puzzling UX thing in the sample app where a 503 from the hosted API surfaces as 'Temporary failure, try again later' with no retry hint. This causes onboarding flakiness.

Liam: Can you paste the raw error?

Maya: Sure
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 503,
    "message": "Temporary failure, try again later",
    "request_id": "req_abc123"
  }
}
```
Also sometimes it's a 429 with the same message and no headers.

Sophie: Are you seeing a Retry-After header there?

Maya: No headers in the sample harness logs. The issue is our JS SDK maps to a generic Error(...) and no typed subclass so caller can't check 'isRetryable'.

Liam: Ugh. SDK parity gap — Python has RetryableError class, JS has none. I thought we fixed this? @Sophie can we standardize mapping of 429/503 -> RetryableError and attach retry_after if present?

Sophie: +1. Also need to parse "x-rate-limit-reset" and "x-retry-after" variants from some proxies.

Alex: This is causing onboarding friction — the quickstart's demo UI retries aggressively and users see duplicate operations or confusing messages.

Maya: Proposed tiny change: SDK should surface structured fields on errors: `.code`, `.status`, `.retryAfterSeconds` (optional), and a boolean `.retryable`. Keep backcompat by making it extend Error. That way sample apps can decide exact backoff behavior.

Liam: Agree. Implementation plan: add typed errors in JS/TS, update runtime mapping, bump SDK minor, update docs, and change quickstart to log headers. We should also add a migration note for anyone doing `instanceof RetryableError`.

Sophie: For auth errors, do NOT mark 401 as retryable by default. There are intermittent 401s from token refresh races we sometimes want to classify as transient but only when the body includes `token_refresh_in_progress`.

Alex: Also update onboarding quickstart to surface the raw headers in the UI console so we catch missing Retry-After during signup. Tiny UX tweak but big signal for DX.

Maya: I'll open a minimal PR with the typed errors + header parsing and a small change to the sample app logging. Will add unit tests.

Liam: Thanks. Also we should add an integration test in the SDK CI that simulates 429/503 with and without Retry-After so we don't regress.

dev-bot: New issue created: RDW-4578 'SDK: typed retryable errors for JS + sample app logging' by Maya.

Sophie: Nice. Can we include tests for parsing `Retry-After: 120` and `Retry-After: <http-date>` formats? And assert we set `retryAfterSeconds` in both cases.

Maya: Yup — adding tests for numeric and http-date parsing, plus a fallback for `x-retry-after`. Will link PR when ready. :thumbsup: 

Alex: Thanks team — this should reduce onboarding confusion and make retry behavior explicit for app authors.
